issues: Toast text on checkout failure reads 'Unable to create checkout session' (passed through from backend HTTPException detail) instead of the spec's suggested 'Could not open checkout'. Both convey failure clearly, but if main agent wants exact spec wording, intercept the 502 in PricingPage.subscribe() and show a friendlier user-facing message.

Naming collision: data-testid='apply-page' is used by BOTH the new EngagementApplyPage and the legacy ApplyPage. Not a bug, but consider renaming the legacy testid to 'apply-program-page' to disambiguate in future tests.

Backend webhook /api/webhook/stripe correctly branches on payment_intent.succeeded (line 2034) and logs the event (line 2039) — confirmed via grep. No DB mutation on this branch (good, since checkout.session.completed is the canonical fulfillment trigger).
